findings.title: New wait-for-queue step in stream_close() is never exercised by a test
findings.claim: The sink's close awaits its end-of-stream send() before close_sink(), so the queue is already empty when stream_close() runs in the test; removing or breaking lines 562-570 fails no test.

findings.title: Doc claim "shut down only once both halves are closed" is false
findings.claim: The connection is also shut down by closing the parent client (abort_all_streams, rpc.cc:848), by the peer reaching EOF (rpc.cc:588), and by the loop-exit stop_send_loop (rpc.cc:1062); the same doc contradicts itself at line 49.

findings.title: Doc claim "reading until it throws closes the source" is false for deserialization errors
findings.claim: When unmarshall throws inside process_one_buffer (rpc_impl.hh:941/951), close_source() is skipped, so stream_close() never runs, contradicting the documented behavior.

findings.title: Test never asserts the hook actually fails with closed_error
findings.claim: The try/catch also accepts a successful return, and detection depends on the flush poller having run (10x yield() does not force a poll) or on a process abort at teardown; should use BOOST_REQUIRE_THROW(..., rpc::closed_error).

findings.title: Test can pass on base code under one ordering, masking the fix's necessity
findings.claim: If the peer's FIN has already made the client loop set _error, the old !_error guard also refuses the frame; the test never checks that error() was still false when the hook fired.

findings.title: Early test failure aborts the whole test binary instead of failing cleanly
findings.claim: If a REQUIRE fails or an unexpected exception is thrown before sink.close(), the stack unwinds with the sink unclosed and release_close never set, and the SEASTAR_ASSERT in ~sink_impl (rpc_impl.hh:935) then aborts the binary instead of failing the test cleanly.

findings.title: const_cast on this inside the const negotiate() method
findings.claim: The factory at line 1801 in the same file keeps its mutable state behind a reference instead; the cast is undefined behaviour if the factory is ever declared const.

findings.title: Comment misstates when _outgoing_queue_ready fails
findings.claim: A comment was claimed to misstate when _outgoing_queue_ready fails, but Codex judged this a false positive.

findings.title: Commits lack the DCO Signed-off-by trailer required by contributing docs
findings.claim: None of the three commits has a DCO Signed-off-by, which doc/contributing.md:6-10 requires; Codex could not decide whether that rule applies to the GitHub PR route.
